equipment.name: CHWS 340K Jack Unit Specification
equipment.details:
CHWS Rig 101 (Short Stroke Jack Unit)

The Rig is a standalone short stroke jack unit suitable for both HWO and Snubbing service on live wells. This Unit can be mounted directly to a wellhead or skidding system for extended workover campaigns. 

KEY SPECIFICATIONS
•Maximum Pressure Capability: 15,000+ psi.  
•Pipe Size Range: 2.375 through 7-5/8 inch, including tubing, drill pipe, casing and all types of BHA and completion components.  
•Workover class rotary system accommodates efficient milling and back reaming. Optional integral 6 port swivel and milling clamp to allow rotation with power slips connected. 
•Horsepower rating: 540 hp x 2 
•Unit 101 Specification Overview
•OEM and Year of Manufacture: Profab/NuEnergy, 2011 (in service 2012)
•Max Lift: 1508 kN (339,120 lbf) 
•Max Snub: 838 kN (188,400 lbf)
•Stroke: 3048mm (10 ft.)
•Rotary Torque Range:
•0-13,810 Nm (0-10,000 lb-ft)
•(with upgrade: to 13,559 Nm (0-10,000 lb-ft)) 
•Rotary Max rpm: 90
•Bore, pressure mode: 279mm (11 inch)
•Bore, workover mode: 279 x 368mm (11" x 14-1/2 inch Work Window)
•Slip Bowl Quantity: 4 ea. Hydraulic Power Slip
•Pipe Range: 60mm thru 193mm (2-3/8" OD to 7-5/8") 
•Pipe Guide System: full range, all tubulars
•Gin Pole, single mode: 16m (51ft) range, 2.0 tonne (6 ton) capacity 
•Counterbalance Winch: dual drum, 1 tonne (2 ton) SWL per side
•Utility Hoist: 4.53 tonne (5 ton) SWL
•HPU: diesel hydraulic, 540 hp x 2
•Max Surface Pressure Capacity: 103+ mPa (15,000 psi+) 
•BOP & BOP Control System: project specific
